<a id="the-least-coupling-with-any-number-of-conditions--任意多条件下最小的耦合"></a>
# The least coupling with any number of conditions

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`sensitivity-is-the-least-coupling` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](sensitivity-is-the-least-coupling.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A law reading finitely many conditions under each history reads through what it is sensitive to: up to double negation, sensitivity is the least coupling. Given a decision of vanishing (giving LPO) the tail law is a counterexample; with numbered conditions every counterexample gives WLPO.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A law reads within a list of conditions under a history where every history agreeing with it on them up to the step gives alike; it reads finitely many conditions where at every step, for every formation and under every history it reads within some list, the list possibly depending on the history (pointwise continuity). Such a law reads what has stood; with finitely many conditions every law of what has stood does. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsWithin`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely.nonanticipating`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.readsWithin_of_every`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.readsFinitely_of_every`)
2. A law of what has stood gives alike under two histories agreeing on what it is sensitive to wherever it reads within a list under one of them. So a law reading finitely many conditions, however many, reads through every coupling by which what it is sensitive to couples in by level, and every one it reads through holds that up to double negation: sensitivity is the least coupling in that sense, and the comparison as the dynamics give follows. (`Becoming.alike_of_sensitive_agree_within`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely.through_of_observed`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely.through_sensitive`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely.least_coupling`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.through_sensitive`, `Becoming.comparison_through_sensitivity_of_readsFinitely`)
3. At a step at which a law is insensitive to every condition, it gives alike under two histories wherever it reads within a list under one of them; a law reading finitely many conditions and sensitive to none gives alike everywhere: what depends on the whole depends on some part. (`Becoming.mixIn_alike_of_insensitiveAt`, `Becoming.alike_of_insensitiveAt_within`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely.alike_of_insensitive`)
4. With infinitely many conditions the list's depending on the history cannot be dropped: a formation exchanging the level of the condition that condition 0's level names reads two conditions under each history, and within no one list under all of them. (`Becoming.Pointer.law`, `Becoming.Pointer.readsWithin`, `Becoming.Pointer.readsFinitely`, `Becoming.Pointer.beyond`, `Becoming.Pointer.lt_beyond`, `Becoming.Pointer.beyond_ne_zero`, `Becoming.Pointer.naming`, `Becoming.Pointer.namingOne`, `Becoming.Pointer.no_list`)
5. Given a decision, for every sequence of levels, of whether it vanishes from some condition on, the tail law exchanges that indicator: it reads what has stood and through the conditions from any one on, is insensitive to every condition and still differs between two histories; it does not read through what it is sensitive to, nor finitely many conditions, and the couplings it reads through have no least one. (`Becoming.VanishFrom`, `Becoming.VanishFrom.of_agree`, `Becoming.vanishIndicator`, `Becoming.vanishIndicator_eq_one`, `Becoming.vanishIndicator_eq_zero`, `Becoming.vanishIndicator_eq_of_agree`, `Becoming.vanishIndicator_zeros`, `Becoming.vanishIndicator_ones`, `Becoming.tailLaw`, `Becoming.tailLaw_nonanticipating`, `Becoming.tailLaw_reads_from`, `Becoming.tailLaw_insensitive`, `Becoming.tailLaw_not_sensitive`, `Becoming.tailLaw_differs`, `Becoming.tailLaw_not_through_sensitive`, `Becoming.tailLaw_not_through`, `Becoming.tailLaw_through_from`, `Becoming.tailLaw_no_least_coupling`, `Becoming.tailLaw_not_readsFinitely`)
6. With conditions numbered by the natural numbers, a law of what has stood giving differently under two histories agreeing on what it is sensitive to gives the weak limited principle of omniscience (every Boolean sequence is false throughout or not), as does any law insensitive at a step to every condition yet differing there. The decision of vanishing gives the limited principle. (`Becoming.WLPO`, `Becoming.WLPO.of_lpo`, `Becoming.ChanceFloors.or_true`, `Becoming.seenBy`, `Becoming.seenBy_false`, `Becoming.seenBy_at`, `Becoming.seenBy_from`, `Becoming.seenBy_true`, `Becoming.alike_of_agree_from`, `Becoming.mixed_decides`, `Becoming.wlpo_of_insensitive_differs`, `Becoming.Sensitivity.cond_either`, `Becoming.alike_of_agree_from_sensitive`, `Becoming.wlpo_of_not_through_sensitive`, `Becoming.seenBy_exists`, `Becoming.lpo_of_vanish_decided`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. What each law needs is written into it: the law reads finitely many conditions (ReadsFinitely) or what has stood (Nonanticipating); decided equality of conditions only for mixing conditions; the tail law takes as a hypothesis a decision, for every sequence of levels, of whether it vanishes eventually; the theorems of omniscience number the conditions by the natural numbers.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That every law reads finitely many conditions: a continuity principle, independent of the core, which the core neither asserts nor denies.
- With infinitely many conditions, reading what has stood does not imply reading through what one is sensitive to (given the decision of vanishing). Witness: `Becoming.tailLaw_not_through_sensitive`.
- Reading finitely many conditions does not imply reading within one list under every history. Witness: `Becoming.Pointer.no_list`.
- What a counterexample gives where the conditions are not numbered by the natural numbers. (With the conditions numbered, a counterexample exists exactly where a rule decides, of every Boolean sequence, whether it is false throughout, the weak limited principle of omniscience as a rule: Becoming.not_through_sensitive_iff_rule.)
- A measure of sensitivity (how much a formation's exchange depends on a condition) or of how much difference arrives; sensitivity read in temporal order; continuous time.
- **Counterexample:** The tail law, given a decision of vanishing (which gives LPO): it reads what has stood, is sensitive to no condition and still differs, and the couplings it reads through have no least one. So the condition cannot be dropped given that decision, and any law dropping it gives WLPO: the core alone neither refutes the condition nor shows it droppable. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Sensitivity.lean)

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren, 12 October 2026, the goal: “move towards 100%, you can spawn a few agents for help, pick the "What would move it most next" first, and don't stop until we are 100%”. This result answers the next_delta of counterfactual-is-the-course: whether, with infinitely many conditions, sensitivity remains the least coupling, or a counterexample. It does wherever the law reads finitely many conditions under each history; otherwise it need not, and with numbered conditions no counterexample can be given in the core without a principle of omniscience. The limited principle of omniscience is Bishop's (1967) and the weak one Bridges and Richman's (1987); that a discontinuous function gives the weak principle is a standard result of constructive reverse mathematics (Ishihara). Readings (the AI's, adopted with exact scope on Ren's delegation, DELEGATED-CHOICES D37; 识 itself, left to Ren, is answered by the naming study's option (b), DELEGATED-CHOICES D45): coupling is sensitivity, what couples into a formation being exactly what its exchange can be changed by, one condition at a time; what depends on the whole depends on some part; what depends on the whole and on no part of it is a tail, like eventual vanishing or a long-run average, the counterpart without probability of Kolmogorov's tail events; that every law reads finitely many conditions is Brouwer's continuity principle, which refutes the weak limited principle and which the core neither states nor refutes.
